37638-child-of-the-regiment.creator: Unknown
37638-child-of-the-regiment.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. , carried her to his tent, and calling his comrades together, told them of the little girl he had found; and no one knowing who she was, or who her parents were, they called her Mary, the Child of the Regiment, and agreed to take care of her as well as they could.

arxiv-2104-11049.title: The relations between the multipole moments in axistationary electrovacuum spacetimes and the N N -soliton solution
arxiv-2104-11049.creator: Etevaldo dos Santos Costa Filho, Angelo Guimarães, I. Cabrera-Munguia
arxiv-2104-11049.description: Abstract A general formulation of the relativistic multipole moments in axistationary electrovac spacetimes is introduced in a closed analytical form. We give a complete description of how the Ernst potentials on the symmetry axis can be completely characterized by these arbitrary multipole moments. Some concrete applications are also developed.

arxiv-2111-07462.title: Federated Learning with Hyperparameter-based Clustering for Electrical Load Forecasting Journal: Journal of L a T e X Templates Journal: Internet of Things
arxiv-2111-07462.creator: Nastaran Gholizadeh, Petr Musilek
arxiv-2111-07462.description: Abstract Electrical load prediction has become an integral part of power system operation. Deep learning models have found popularity for this purpose. However, to achieve a desired prediction accuracy, they require huge amounts of data for training. Sharing electricity consumption data of individual households for load prediction may compromise user privacy and can be expensive in terms of communication resources.

arxiv-2206-00428.title: Rotational energy extraction from the Kerr black hole’s mimickers
arxiv-2206-00428.creator: Vishva Patel, Kauntey Acharya, Parth Bambhaniya, Pankaj S. Joshi
arxiv-2206-00428.description: Abstract In this paper, the Penrose process is being used to extract rotational energy from regular black holes. Initially, we consider the rotating Simpson-Visser regular spacetime which describes the class of geometries of the Kerr black hole’s mimickers. The Penrose process is then studied through conformally transformed rotating singular and regular black hole solutions.

arxiv-2304-06872.title: Submerse: Visualizing Storm Surge Flooding Simulations in Immersive Display Ecologies
arxiv-2304-06872.creator: Saeed Boorboor, Yoonsang Kim, Ping Hu, Josef M. Moses, Brian A. Colle, and Arie E. Kaufman
arxiv-2304-06872.description: Abstract We present Submerse , an end-to-end framework for visualizing flooding scenarios on large and immersive display ecologies. Specifically, we reconstruct a surface mesh from input flood simulation data and generate a to-scale 3D virtual scene by incorporating geographical data such as terrain, textures, buildings, and additional scene objects.

arxiv-2308-03527.title: Exploring ChatGPT’s Empathic Abilities
arxiv-2308-03527.creator: Kristina Schaaff, Caroline Reinig, Tim Schlippe
arxiv-2308-03527.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Kristina Schaaff, Caroline Reinig, Tim Schlippe. Empathy is often understood as the ability to share and understand another individual’s state of mind or emotion. With the increasing use of chatbots in various domains, e.g., children seeking help with homework, individuals looking for medical advice, and people using the chatbot as a daily source of everyday companionship, the importance of empathy in human-computer interaction has become more apparent.

arxiv-2402-05942.creator: Michael Livanos, Ian Davidson, Stephen Wong

arxiv-2503-03654.creator: Jessica Hoffmann, Christiane Ahlheim, Zac Yu, Aria Walfrand, Jarvis Jin, Marie Tano, Ahmad Beirami, Erin van Liemt, Nithum Thain, Hakim Sidahmed, Lucas Dixon
arxiv-2503-03654.description: Abstract . This paper describes the construction of a dataset and the evaluation of training methods to improve generative large language models’ (LLMs) ability to answer queries on sensitive topics with a Neutral Point of View (NPOV), i.e., to provide significantly more informative, diverse and impartial answers.

arxiv-2601-12868.title: Race, Ethnicity and Their Implication on Bias in Large Language Models
arxiv-2601-12868.creator: Shiyue Hu, Ruizhe Li, Yanjun Gao
arxiv-2601-12868.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) increasingly operate in high-stakes settings including healthcare and medicine, where demographic attributes such as race and ethnicity may be explicitly stated or implicitly inferred from text. However, existing studies primarily document outcome-level disparities, offering limited insight into internal mechanisms underlying these effects.

arxiv-2601-19942.title: Latent Object Permanence: Topological Phase Transitions, Free-Energy Principles, and Renormalization Group Flows in Deep Transformer Manifolds
arxiv-2601-19942.creator: Faruk Alpay, Bugra Kilictas
arxiv-2601-19942.description: Abstract The emergent capability of Large Language Models (LLMs) to perform multi-step reasoning suggests an internal mechanism that behaves as if it discretizes continuous representations into stable, reusable units. We model this phenomenon as a phase transition in the geometry of a latent activation manifold ℳ \mathcal{M} across depth.

pmc-10647838.creator: Henry Madubuike, Natalie Ferry
pmc-10647838.description: Current demands for the development of suitable biocatalysts showing high process performance is stimulated by the need to replace current chemical synthesis with cleaner alternatives. A drawback to the use of biocatalysts for unique applications is their low performance in industrial conditions. Hence, enzymes with improved performance are needed to achieve innovative and sustainable biocatalysis.

pmc-11516472.title: First things first: measuring French Medical schools’ deans motivation to engage in smoke-free campus
pmc-11516472.creator: D Geindreau, A Girault, K Gallopel-Morvan
pmc-11516472.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Smoke-free campuses (SFC) prohibit smoking and vaping on all university grounds and for all users. Around a hundred of papers was published on that topic revealing how they reduce initiation and increase smoking cessation among students. Whereas it is key for the success of all project, including SFC, very rare research has investigated attitude of high-level leaders of universities toward SFC, their perceived barriers and motivation to adopt it.

pmc-12594899.title: Enhancement of dielectric and conductive properties of Mn2O3 nanoparticles in liquid crystal under argon radio frequency plasma
pmc-12594899.creator: Mahsa Khadem Sadigh, M. A. Mohammadi, F. Baharlounezhad, A. Ranjkesh
pmc-12594899.description: In this study, the effects of Ar radio plasma on Mn2O3 nanoparticles and their influence on the permittivity and electrical properties of doped nematic liquid crystal were investigated. The nanoparticles were plasma-treated at different times and then added to the liquid crystal. The size of the nanoparticles and the surface morphology changed with increasing plasma application time.

pmc-12947752.title: Recent developments in the organocatalytic asymmetric cycloaddition/annulation reactions involving indolylmethanols
pmc-12947752.creator: Arun Patel, Harshit, Eldhose Iype, Indresh Kumar
pmc-12947752.description: Enantioenriched indole frameworks constitute the structural core of a wide array of biologically active natural products and therapeutic agents; as such, their synthesis has emerged as a central and enduring objective in organic synthesis. In this regard, suitably substituted indolylmethanols have emerged as versatile precursors to a series of catalytic asymmetric transformations to construct complex indole-based architectures.

pmc-13138269.title: Genetic Features and Clinical Heterogeneity of Leber Hereditary Optic Neuropathy in Adolescent and Adult Patients: A Case Series on Arab Patients
pmc-13138269.creator: Esraa Basalem, Nooran Badeeb
pmc-13138269.description: Leber hereditary optic neuropathy (LHON) is a rare disorder characterized by painless progressive visual loss. LHON is caused by maternally inherited mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) point mutations, impairing the electron transport chain and oxidative phosphorylation. Environmental and nuclear factors may further influence disease manifestation.

pmc-13209145.title: A Global Study of Skin and Subcutaneous Diseases Among Individuals Under 20 Years of Age
pmc-13209145.creator: Xiju He, Na Feng, Junjie Chang, Xiaomin Huang, Tao Zhu, Wenrui Min, Xinxin Wang, Zudong Meng, Yulin Zou
pmc-13209145.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundSkin diseases are chronic and recurrent conditions that impose substantial disability and long-term psychosocial burden. However, the global burden of pediatric skin diseases has been insufficiently studied.MethodsWe extracted age-specific data for individuals younger than 20 years from GBD 2021. A comprehensive analytical framework was applied, including Joinpoint regression analysis, SDI frontier analysis, Bayesian age–period–cohort (BAPC) modeling, and ARIMA time-series forecasting to evaluate temporal trends and predict future disease burden.

pmc-13633737.title: Intramedullary Nailing of Femoral Shaft Fractures: Implications of Interlocking Screw Breakage
pmc-13633737.creator: Eric T Metzman, Josue Balbuena, Taylor T Utter, Rodolfo Zamora
pmc-13633737.description: IntroductionFemoral shaft fractures are commonly treated with intramedullary nailing (IMN), though complications such as delayed union, nonunion, and hardware failure remain significant challenges. Interlocking screw breakage has unclear implications for fracture healing. Our study examined patients with femoral shaft fractures treated with IMN who developed interlocking screw breakage to evaluate outcomes and complications.
